points.title: 早年生活
points.description: 勃列日涅夫出生于乌克兰卡缅斯科耶的一个工人家庭。他的父亲是冶金厂工人，母亲是家庭主妇。这段时期，他经历了第一次世界大战和俄国革命，这些重大历史事件对他后来的政治立场产生了深远影响。童年时期，他接受了基本教育，并在当地冶金厂工作，这段工人经历使他始终保持着与普通劳动者的联系，也成为他日后政治生涯的重要资本。
points.descriptionEn: Brezhnev was born in Kamenskoye, Ukraine, to a working-class family. His father worked in a metallurgical plant, and his mother was a housewife. During this period, he experienced World War I and the Russian Revolution, which profoundly influenced his later political stance. As a child, he received basic education and worked at the local metallurgical plant, an experience that kept him connected to ordinary workers and became an important asset in his political career.

points.place: 乌克兰第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克
points.title: 教育与早期政治生涯
points.description: 1923年，勃列日涅夫开始在第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克的冶金技术学校学习，同时积极参与共青团活动。1929年，他加入苏联共产党，开始在党内崭露头角。1931-1935年，他在库尔斯克和别尔哥罗德等地担任共青团领导职务。1935年，他毕业于第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克工业学院，获得冶金工程师学位。这一时期，他积累了丰富的基层工作经验，建立了广泛的人脉网络，为日后在政坛的发展奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1923, Brezhnev began studying at the Dnipro Metallurgical Technical School while actively participating in Komsomol activities. In 1929, he joined the Communist Party of the Soviet Union and began to stand out in party affairs. From 1931 to 1935, he held leadership positions in the Komsomol in Kursk and Belgorod. In 1935, he graduated from the Dnipro Industrial Institute with a degree in metallurgical engineering. During this period, he gained extensive grassroots experience and built a wide network of contacts, laying the foundation for his future political development.

points.title: 二战军事生涯
points.description: 二战爆发后，勃列日涅夫加入苏联红军，担任政治委员职务。他从乌克兰前线开始，参与了斯大林格勒战役、解放乌克兰等重大军事行动。1943年，他被授予少将军衔，成为苏联军队中最年轻的政治委员之一。战争期间，他表现出色，多次获得勋章，包括苏沃洛夫勋章和库图佐夫勋章。这段军事经历不仅提升了他的威望，也使他建立了与军队的紧密联系，成为日后政治生涯中的重要资本。战后，他继续在敖德萨等地的军队中担任政治工作，直到1946年退役。
points.descriptionEn: After the outbreak of World War II, Brezhnev joined the Red Army and served as a political commissar. He began on the Ukrainian front and participated in major military operations such as the Battle of Stalingrad and the liberation of Ukraine. In 1943, he was promoted to the rank of major general, becoming one of the youngest political commissars in the Soviet army. During the war, he performed exceptionally well and received multiple decorations, including the Order of Suvorov and the Order of Kutuzov. This military experience not only enhanced his prestige but also established his close ties with the military, which became an important asset in his later political career. After the war, he continued to serve in political positions in the army in Odessa until his retirement in 1946.

points.title: 哈萨克斯坦时期
points.description: 1954年，勃列日涅夫被派往哈萨克斯坦担任第一书记，负责领导垦荒运动。在这一时期，他大力推动农业发展，建立了许多新的集体农庄和工业设施。1956年，他回到莫斯科，担任苏共中央书记处书记，负责国防工业。1957年，他支持赫鲁晓夫反对莫洛托夫等人的'反党集团'，巩固了赫鲁晓夫对他的信任。1960年，他担任苏联最高苏维埃主席团主席，成为国家元首。1963年，他当选为苏共中央委员会书记，1964年又当选为苏共中央第一书记，实际上成为苏联的最高领导人。
points.descriptionEn: In 1954, Brezhnev was sent to Kazakhstan as First Secretary, responsible for leading the Virgin Lands Campaign. During this period, he vigorously promoted agricultural development, establishing many new collective farms and industrial facilities. In 1956, he returned to Moscow and served as a Secretary of the Central Committee of the CPSU, overseeing defense industries. In 1957, he supported Khrushchev against the 'anti-party group' led by Molotov, consolidating Khrushchev's trust in him. In 1960, he became Chairman of the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet, making him the head of state. In 1963, he was elected Secretary of the Central Committee of the CPSU, and in 1964, he became First Secretary of the Central Committee, effectively becoming the supreme leader of the Soviet Union.

points.title: 苏联领导人
points.description: 1964年，勃列日涅夫发动政变推翻赫鲁晓夫，成为苏联最高领导人。执政初期，他推行'稳定化'政策，结束了赫鲁晓夫时期的政治动荡，提高了人民生活水平。1968年，他主导了入侵捷克斯洛伐克的事件，镇压'布拉格之春'，确立了'勃列日涅夫主义'，即苏联有权干涉社会主义国家的内部事务。1970年代，苏联军事实力达到顶峰，与美国展开军备竞赛。1979年，他下令入侵阿富汗，导致苏联陷入长达十年的战争泥潭。1970年代末至1980年代初，苏联经济停滞，政治腐败严重，形成了所谓的'停滞时期'。尽管如此，他在苏联国内仍保持着较高的支持率，直到1982年去世。
points.descriptionEn: In 1964, Brezhnev led a coup to overthrow Khrushchev and became the supreme leader of the Soviet Union. In the early years of his rule, he implemented a 'stabilization' policy, ending the political turmoil of the Khrushchev era and improving people's living standards. In 1968, he masterminded the invasion of Czechoslovakia, suppressing the 'Prague Spring,' and established the 'Brezhnev Doctrine,' which held that the Soviet Union had the right to interfere in the internal affairs of socialist countries. In the 1970s, Soviet military power reached its peak, and the country engaged in an arms race with the United States. In 1979, he ordered the invasion of Afghanistan, leading to a decade-long quagmire for the Soviet Union. From the late 1970s to the early 1980s, the Soviet economy stagnated, and political corruption became rampant, creating what became known as the 'Era of Stagnation.' Despite this, he maintained relatively high popularity in the Soviet Union until his death in 1982.

points.title: 晚年与遗产
points.description: 勃列日涅夫晚年健康状况急剧恶化，多次中风，但仍坚持执政。这一时期，苏联的'停滞时期'达到顶峰，经济停滞不前，政治腐败严重，社会矛盾日益尖锐。尽管如此，勃列日涅夫仍保持着表面的威望，获得了多项荣誉和勋章。1982年11月10日，勃列日涅夫在莫斯科去世，享年76岁。他的葬礼是苏联历史上最隆重的葬礼之一，吸引了众多外国领导人参加。勃列日涅夫的统治时期被称为'停滞时期'，这一时期苏联的军事实力达到顶峰，但经济和社会问题日益严重，为苏联后来的解体埋下了伏笔。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Brezhnev's health deteriorated rapidly, with multiple strokes, but he continued to rule. During this period, the Soviet 'Era of Stagnation' reached its peak, with economic stagnation, rampant political corruption, and growing social tensions. Despite this, Brezhnev maintained his apparent prestige and received numerous honors and awards. On November 10, 1982, Brezhnev died in Moscow at the age of 76. His funeral was one of the most elaborate in Soviet history, attended by many foreign leaders. Brezhnev's rule period is known as the 'Era of Stagnation,' during which the Soviet Union's military power reached its peak, but economic and social problems became increasingly severe, laying the groundwork for the subsequent dissolution of the Soviet Union.

appraisal.zh: 勃列日涅夫通常被定位为“停滞时期”的象征：其统治下苏联军力达于顶峰、表面堪与美国并立，但经济停滞、技术落后与官僚特权同步滋长，入侵捷克斯洛伐克和阿富汗更重创其国际声誉，过度依赖石油收入又延误了结构改革，因而被视为苏联由盛转衰的转折点。也有研究者指出，他结束了赫鲁晓夫时期的政治动荡，带来相对平稳的发展阶段并改善了民众生活水平。
appraisal.en: Brezhnev is generally cast as the symbol of the Era of Stagnation: under him Soviet military power peaked and the country appeared to stand on par with the United States, yet economic stagnation, technological backwardness and bureaucratic privilege grew together, the invasions of Czechoslovakia and Afghanistan badly damaged his international standing, and over-reliance on oil revenues postponed structural reform, making his rule a turning point from strength to decline. Some researchers note, however, that he ended the political turmoil of the Khrushchev years, brought a relatively stable period of development and improved living standards.

supporter.zh: 勃列日涅夫被视为苏联历史上最稳定的领导人之一，他结束了赫鲁晓夫时期的政治动荡，提高了苏联人民的生活水平。在他的领导下，苏联军事实力达到顶峰，成为与美国并驾齐驱的超级大国。他推行的'稳定化'政策为苏联社会带来了相对平静的发展时期，同时他重视国防建设，确保了苏联在国际舞台上的地位。勃列日涅夫还重视与第三世界国家的合作，扩大了苏联的国际影响力。
supporter.en: Brezhnev is regarded as one of the most stable leaders in Soviet history, ending the political turmoil of the Khrushchev era and improving the living standards of the Soviet people. Under his leadership, the Soviet Union's military power reached its peak, becoming a superpower on par with the United States. His 'stabilization' policy brought a relatively peaceful period of development for Soviet society, and he emphasized defense construction, ensuring the Soviet Union's position on the international stage. Brezhnev also valued cooperation with Third World countries, expanding the Soviet Union's international influence.

critic.zh: 批评者认为勃列日涅夫的统治是苏联衰落的开始，他推行的'停滞政策'导致经济停滞、技术落后和腐败盛行。他入侵捷克斯洛伐克和阿富汗的决策严重损害了苏联的国际声誉，并使苏联陷入长期战争泥潭。勃列日涅夫时期的特权阶层和官僚主义日益严重，社会创新精神受到压制。此外，他过度依赖石油出口收入，忽视了经济结构的改革，为苏联后来的经济危机埋下了隐患。
critic.en: Critics argue that Brezhnev's rule marked the beginning of the Soviet Union's decline. His 'stagnation policy' led to economic stagnation, technological backwardness, and rampant corruption. His decisions to invade Czechoslovakia and Afghanistan severely damaged the Soviet Union's international reputation and plunged the country into long-term quagmires. The privileged class and bureaucracy became increasingly severe during Brezhnev's era, and social innovation was suppressed. Additionally, his over-reliance on oil export revenues and neglect of economic structural reform laid the groundwork for the Soviet Union's subsequent economic crisis.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，勃列日涅夫常被定义为'停滞时期'的象征，这一时期苏联表面强大但内部问题丛生。他的形象复杂多变，既有维护国家稳定的务实一面，也有导致苏联走向衰落的保守一面。勃列日涅夫主义成为国际政治术语，指代苏联干涉社会主义国家内政的政策。他的统治时期被视为苏联从强盛到衰落的转折点，为研究超级大国兴衰提供了重要案例。在流行文化中，勃列日涅夫常被描绘为一位喜欢勋章、讲话冗长的领导人，成为苏联时代的一个标志性符号。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Brezhnev is often defined as the symbol of the 'Era of Stagnation,' a period when the Soviet Union appeared strong but was plagued by internal problems. His image is complex and multifaceted, showing both a pragmatic side in maintaining national stability and a conservative side that led to the Soviet Union's decline. The 'Brezhnev Doctrine' has become a term in international politics referring to the Soviet policy of interfering in the internal affairs of socialist countries. His rule period is seen as a turning point in the Soviet Union's trajectory from strength to decline, providing an important case study for the rise and fall of superpowers. In popular culture, Brezhnev is often depicted as a leader who loved medals and gave long speeches, becoming an iconic symbol of the Soviet era.

self.zh: 我们的政策是和平共处，但不是投降。
self.en: Our policy is peaceful coexistence, but not surrender.
